component.name: Lumen
component.summary: A fast, safe viewer and editor for pictures and PDFs

description.p: Lumen opens pictures and PDFs quickly and keeps them safe. It is written in pure Rust, with no C code in the document path, and decodes pictures in a sandboxed process.
View pictures and PDFs, flip through a folder, search and select text, fill in forms, draw and highlight, sign, turn and crop pictures, organise PDF pages, and print.

ul.li: PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP, TIFF, BMP, JPEG XL, JPEG 2000, OpenEXR, SVG and more, with animation
PDF reading with contents, search, links, forms and password-protected files
Markup saved as real PDF annotations, and handwritten signatures
Page organiser, export to PNG or PDF, night mode, slideshow

description.p: A toolbar joined to the header, with one row of tools under it, and files that open by themselves instead of with their whole folder.
Tools no longer cover the page, the sidebar can be resized, contents can be folded, a zoom menu, and a Reduce motion preference.
Dialogs whose buttons are always in view, right-click menus, a shorter main menu, one set of controls, page ranges when printing, and hints that go away.
Select a part of a picture, discard changes, choose the language; steady zoom and a smooth pen.
Lumen runs on macOS and Windows too, with each system's own dialogs, trash, clipboard and file watching.
Fixes: the picture decoder fails closed and stays within limits, saving never loses or exposes data, PDFs keep what other programs wrote in them, and many smaller defects.
First release: pictures, PDFs, markup, forms, signatures, picture editing, page organising, export, printing, slideshow, preferences, sandboxed decoding, Spanish translation.
